correctness.rationale: PASS: The exact Bessel recurrence gives Phi=1-nu^2/x^2+(Jnu'/Jnu)^2 and x Phi'/2=1-(1+x Jnu'/Jnu)Phi. Source uniqueness is supplied by Aktaş-Baricz; uniform oscillatory differentiated Debye expansion on a compact subset t>1 localizes the stationary minimizer at phase n*pi+O(1/nu), t=t_nu,n+O(nu^-2). The explicit Debye sine coefficient B=1/(8u)+5/(24u^3) solves the phase correction to -(9t^2+22)/(24(t^2-1)^(3/2)), yielding location coefficient -t(9t^2+22)/(24(t^2-1)^2) and minimum coefficient -(9t^2+10)/(12 t^2(t^2-1)^2). Parity of Debye terms justifies O_K(nu^-4) remainders, not merely O(nu^-3). Independent SciPy and symbolic checks corroborated 5 integer/noninteger large-order pairs without substituting finite samples for asymptotic proof.
